title: Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) Registrations Held per Beneficiary
content:
A beneficiary may hold one Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) registration at a time; several children of one sponsor each hold their own registration. A new request for a beneficiary whose registration is applied or registered is not a second registration. The beneficiary has no applied or registered ECHO registration.

## The rule as the registration desk applies it

- **Limit.** At most 1 ECHO registration per beneficiary at a time.
- **Unit.** The registration belongs to the beneficiary with the qualifying condition, not to the sponsor. Each child of the same sponsor is a separate beneficiary and holds a registration of their own.
- **Registering condition.** A new ECHO registration request is recorded for a beneficiary only where the beneficiary has no applied or registered ECHO registration.
- **Basis of the check.** The condition is read from the company's own ECHO registration records for that same beneficiary, as they stand before the new registration is recorded; it is not settled by what the caller states.
- **Date of the request.** A new request received on a different date from the open one is still not a second registration while the earlier registration for that beneficiary is applied or registered.

## Registration status and the condition

| Status of the beneficiary's existing ECHO registration | Counts as an applied or registered registration |
|---|---|
| applied (request received, not yet decided) | yes |
| registered (in effect) | yes |
| denied | no |
| closed at the family's request | no |
| closed for loss of eligibility | no |

## Hypothetical cases, for illustration only

| Case | Existing ECHO registrations on record | Does the condition hold for the new request? |
|---|---|---|
| A | none for this beneficiary | yes |
| B | this beneficiary's registration is registered | no; the new request is not a second registration |
| C | this beneficiary's earlier registration was denied | yes, as far as this condition goes |
| D | a sibling (same sponsor) holds a registered registration; none for this beneficiary | yes; the sibling's registration is the sibling's own |
| E | this beneficiary's registration is applied, and a further request arrives a month later | no |
